title: coleus tetragonus
intro: Coleus tetragonus, commonly known as the "Khatta" or "Wild Coleus," is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, native to tropical and subtropical regions of the world. The health benefits of Coleus tetragonus include its use as a natural remedy for various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an analgesic, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Coleus tetragonus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
